timed_region: Each rank measures the complete simulation loop from immediately before the loop through a post-loop MPI barrier. Initialization and final device-to-host result collection are outside the timed region.
start_synchronization: MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD) precedes each rank's local start timestamp at unstructured/unstructured.cpp:298-299. Although barrier returns need not be simultaneous, correctness does not depend on simultaneous starts because complete local durations are aggregated with MPI_MAX.
stop_synchronization: Every CUDA kernel is followed by cudaDeviceSynchronize at unstructured/unstructured.cpp:342-348. After the simulation loop, all ranks enter MPI_Barrier before recording their local end timestamps at lines 353-354, so accelerator work and rank-local computation are complete before timing stops.
rank_aggregation: Each rank converts its elapsed interval to milliseconds, then MPI_Allreduce combines the long-long local durations using MPI_MAX at unstructured/unstructured.cpp:355 and 366-370.
reported_value: Rank 0 prints the MPI_MAX result under the canonical label "Computation time" in milliseconds at unstructured/unstructured.cpp:372-373.
semantic_equivalence_basis: Every rank times its complete local simulation, asynchronous GPU work is completed before the local stop, and the elapsed durations are reduced with MPI_MAX. Integer-millisecond truncation is monotonic and therefore preserves the maximum up to permitted display precision.

evidence.finding: A communicator barrier precedes the local start timestamp, and the simulation loop begins afterward on every rank.
The timed computation includes blocking halo exchanges, CUDA kernel launches, and cudaDeviceSynchronize after each launch.
A post-computation communicator barrier occurs before the local end timestamp and elapsed-millisecond calculation.
The complete local elapsed durations are aggregated with MPI_Allreduce using MPI_LONG_LONG and MPI_MAX, and rank 0 prints that result as "Computation time".

notes: The timed interval includes synchronization overhead at the final barrier and excludes final result copies and collection; both choices are permitted by the timing contract.
